front: Channel vital energy to restore Hit Points to a willing living creature or damage an undead one. More actions spent means more range and reach.
back:
Living: restore 1d8 HP. Undead: that much vitality damage, basic Fortitude save.
1 action: range touch.
2 actions (concentrate): range 30 feet; living target regains an extra 8 HP.
3 actions (concentrate): 30-foot emanation hitting all living and undead creatures in it.
Heightened (+1): healing/damage +1d8; the 2-action bonus healing +8.
